note: Operating values of the session app (docs/protocol/session_app_spec_v0.md, decided 2026-11-27). Every key cites its source. Changing a value means a new version of this file, not an edit of a used one.

slots_per_phase.source: protocol 6.4 'So lan bom': M0 twice, M1 and M2 once each

screening_source: protocol 4 and 6.4: two inflations (both arms) at screening in session 1, counted for the cap and safety only

inflation_cap.source: protocol 6.4: cap 6 per session (4 when only M0), plus the 2 screening inflations in session 1

repeat_source: SAP v1 section 2 and protocol 6.4 (decided 2026-11-27): repeats only at M0, at most 2 per session
rest_source: protocol 6.2: at least 2 minutes between two inflations

safety.source: docs/ethics/session_safety_stopping_v0.1.md section 6 (a), (b); any reading incl. screening for (a), mean of the M0 readings for (b); safety only, never a data filter

label_ranges.source: spec 10.1 point 15: outside asks for confirmation, never refused
